title: 第一卷 第77章 老鸨的本体果真是一只老鸡婆第一卷 第76章 干一票大的
lines: “阿渊，此人便是春梦楼大管事，李兴。”
陈建明开口低声解释。
他代管陈家产业十年，从青涩少年历练到处事圆融，天庆郡各大势力高层，他几乎全都熟识。
“这些被掳来的女子，待到客人玩腻之后，便会被他当作炉鼎修炼。”
“而他背后的靠山，正是官方五大家族，春梦楼不过是他们暗中掌控的产业。”
“赌场、青楼、这类灰色行当，皆由他们掌控。”
“除此之外，炼器、阵法、炼丹、驭兽四道，他们也一直暗中觊觎插手。”
“除却我们陈家把持的炼丹一道，其余三道皆被他们染指。”
陈建明一番话落下，陈渊众人眸中寒意更盛。
陈渊也瞬间了然，这些灰色行当之所以肆无忌惮、横行无忌，原来是有官方世家在背后撑腰。
天庆郡官方五大家族，分别为：牛家、苟家、孙家、齐家、卢家。
五家联手，暗中掌控郡内大半资源与势力。
“眼下怎么办？要不要传信请叔公他们赶来支援？”
陈建明面色凝重，压低声音问道。
陈建初连忙附和点头，主张立刻摇人求援。
陈渊微微颔首，认可求援的主意。
面对一尊黄庭境中期的道人，即便以他的实力，也没有十足胜算。
他暗中轻轻拍了拍糯米的小手。
下一刻，糯米身形悄然化作透明，隐入虚空无人察觉。
陈昭宁察觉到身旁气息变化，望着空无一人的身边，不由得目瞪口呆。
这时，陈渊陡然高声开口，“我等是人族天骄又如何？绝非无端寻衅闹事！”
声音响彻厅堂，二楼的李兴与一楼的老者李春，皆是眸光一眯，面露讥讽之色。
“怎么，想服软求饶？可惜，晚了。”
李春冷声开口，率领上百护卫持刀持戈，杀气腾腾步步逼近。
陈渊沉声冷喝，“你们公然掳掠女子、逼良为娼，罪大恶极，已然触犯大相帝国律法！”
“我早已派人通报执法卫前来查办，你这老鸡头，就等着伏法受死吧！”
这话一出，全场众人皆是一愣。
就连陈昭宁几人也诧异看向陈渊，没想到他竟会借官方律法当作震慑！
这可是官方勾结的生意，难道让官方高坐堂上，大骂一句，堂下何人状告本官？
“不错，掳掠良家、逼良为娼之事，虽暗中不少人默许！”
“官方也一向睁一只眼闭一只眼，却绝不敢摆到明面上公然纵容！”
张山眼中一亮，忍不住开口赞同，觉得这法子极为妥当。
“呵呵，是吗？”
二楼的李兴俯视下方，满脸讥讽，“你口口声声说我春梦楼掳掠良家，那便是有众生户籍在身的女子，被强掳至此了？呵，你可有真凭实据？”
闻言，陈渊看向厉守仁。
厉守仁连忙环顾四周，脸色骤变：“不好，牛金花她们三人呢？”
“不是你一路盯着她们吗？”
张山愕然问道。
“我以为她们跟在身后，不曾留意。”
content_en:
"A Yuan, this person is the chief manager of Chunmeng Tower, Li Xing."
Chen Jianming opened his mouth to explain in a low voice.
He has been in charge of the Chen family's property for ten years, and has grown from a young boy to a smooth man. He is familiar with almost all the top leaders of the major forces in Tianqing County.
"These abducted women will be used as a furnace for training by the guests after they get tired of playing with them."
"And the backers behind him are the five major official families. Chunmeng Tower is just an industry they secretly control."
"Casinos, brothels, and other gray businesses are all controlled by them."
"In addition, they have also been secretly coveting to get involved in the four areas of weapon refining, formation formation, alchemy, and beast control."
"Except for the alchemy path controlled by our Chen family, the other three paths are all controlled by them."
After Chen Jianming finished speaking, everyone in Chen Yuan felt even colder in their eyes.
Chen Yuan also instantly understood that the reason why these gray businesses were unscrupulous and unscrupulous was that they had the support of official families.
The five official families in Tianqing County are: Niu family, Gou family, Sun family, Qi family, and Lu family.
The five families have joined forces to secretly control most of the resources and power in the county.
"What should we do now? Should we send a message to ask my uncle and the others to come for support?"
Chen Jianming looked solemn and asked in a lowered voice.
Chen Jianchu quickly nodded in agreement, advocating calling for help immediately.
Chen Yuan nodded slightly and agreed with the idea of ​​asking for help.
Facing a Taoist who is in the middle stage of Huangting realm, even with his strength, he has no chance of winning.
He secretly patted Nuomi's little hand.
The next moment, Nuomi's figure quietly turned transparent and disappeared into the void without anyone noticing.
Chen Zhaoning noticed the change in the aura around him, looked at the empty place, and couldn't help but be stunned.
At this time, Chen Yuan suddenly spoke loudly, "So what if we are the geniuses of the human race? We are definitely not provoking troubles for no reason!"
The voice resounded throughout the hall. Li Xing on the second floor and Li Chun, the old man on the first floor, both narrowed their eyes with sarcasm on their faces.
"What, you want to surrender and beg for mercy? Unfortunately, it's too late."
Li Chun spoke coldly, leading hundreds of guards with swords and guns, approaching step by step with murderous intent.
"Hmph!"
Chen Yuan shouted coldly, "You openly robbed women and forced girls into prostitution. Your crimes are extremely heinous. You have violated the laws of the Prime Minister's Empire!"
"I have already sent someone to notify the law enforcement guards to come and investigate. You old chicken head, just wait to die!"
As soon as these words came out, everyone in the audience was stunned.
Even Chen Zhaoning and others looked at Chen Yuan in surprise, not expecting that he would use official laws as a deterrent!
This is a business colluded by the government. Should the government sit high in the hall and curse loudly? Who in the hall will sue me?
"Yes, many people secretly agree to rob good families and force them into prostitution!"
"The officials have always turned a blind eye, but they never dare to show their condolences openly!"
Zhang Shan's eyes lit up and he couldn't help but agree. He felt that this method was extremely appropriate.
"Haha, really?"
Li Xing on the second floor looked down, his face full of sarcasm, "You keep saying that I, Chunmeng Tower, robbed good families, but that is a woman with a registered permanent residence who was kidnapped here? Oh, do you have any real evidence?"
Hearing this, Chen Yuan looked at Li Shouren.
Li Shouren quickly looked around and his expression suddenly changed: "No, where are Niu Jinhua and the other three?"
"Didn't you keep an eye on them all the way?"
Zhang Shan asked in astonishment.
"I thought they were following behind and didn't pay attention."
